annotations.title: Resolve an address, postcode or area to place refs

description:
Turn an address, a postcode or an area name into canonical place refs. Call
    this FIRST whenever you only have text: it is the only tool that accepts
    free text. Each candidate carries a `place` ({uprn} | {postcode} | {area})
    to pass to the other tools, and address candidates carry `identity`:
    unit | building | street | unresolved. Treat anything but `unit` as "may be
    a block, not one home": ask the user which flat, never assume. `unresolved`
    means the source did not state precision.

    Returns at most 10 candidates, newest page via `next_cursor`. A postcode or
    district is recognised from its shape; an area name or an address is looked
    up. It is always free. Set `list_addresses` with a full postcode to list the addresses at it (paged).
    `near_lat` and `near_lng` (give both) rank nearest first.

    Do NOT use it to value anything or for areas outside the UK. Limits: area
    codes are ONS/GSS codes held for English local authorities only; Welsh and
    Scottish authorities and postcode-district names return covered=false with
    the reason. A call with covered=false or an upstream failure is not charged.
    Free. Costs nothing.
name: resolve_place
title: Resolve an address, postcode or area to place refs
